Night Visitor (Night Visitor (page 22)) What is the identity of the man in black? What kind of terrorist force lurks behind the man in black? Li Chen is not stupid, but he doesn't want to get involved in other people's affairs, so he just found an excuse and got up to prepare for today's shooting. Compared with the bustle below the mountain gate, the Qingxiang Hall was a little deserted. A thousand-year-old pine was half leaning against the hall, and a beautiful figure stood under the tree. She stood like a virgin, she It moves slightly, like the breeze. Not to mention the star-picking, the peak of the Nascent Realm is not even weak against the Poji Realm. With the help of the Divine Forbidden Weapon Colorful Memories, it is completely possible to achieve the extremely difficult cross-realm beheading. , although I won’t feel better afterward. “Giggle! Really! I wasn’t scared away so casually!” Fairy Huashan smiled coquettishly and said softly, “But you can’t say that the other party is 100% able to break out. Break out?" Fan Xing still wanted to quibble. However, Jiang Tian and others only improved the level of dragon transformation, and finally completed the perfect dragon transformation. "Huh!" The more he thought about it, the more angry he became. Zhang Jun almost flipped the table with a cold snort, but Unfortunately, in front of Li Yang, he really didn't have the courage. Facing the imminent moves of the Sui Empire forces inside and outside the city, Fang Jiyan and Ma Han were very anxious. After all, they were deep behind enemy lines. If they failed, they would not only be defeated and killed, but they would also be delayed. The important task assigned by His Majesty was put aside. As a mafia leader, having this kind of solar alloy that can only be produced by the Great Temple sounds quite inconsistent. However, considering that Hayate once worked as a mercenary and helped the Great Temple on many important tasks, Lu Xi was relieved. It was not to directly restore spiritual power, but to speed up the recovery process by nourishing the Fengchen Meridian and Dantian.
